"Every battlefield the Hostile Environment Troops find themselves on, is a hostile, bombarded and chemically saturated one. Taking trenches, cities and sectors require troops in the thousands, and waiting for weeks or months on end for the right moment to strike. To that end, Command uses Shock Assault Troops, Specialists in lightning warfare.

Other armies decorate these soldiers in honors, having them as elite regiments on their planets. The best of the best.
Not so for the Hostile Environment Troops, for in the hellish condition they find themselves in, a simple hole in their suits means they are living on borrowed time.
Most, but not all, Shock Assault are penal legionaires, promised freedom if they survive a single attack on an enemy position. Very few survive to see reinforcements, fewer still survive long enough for a commissar to excuse them of their sins and turn them free men and women.

The life of a Shock Assault Trooper is a short and deadly life, but their sacrifices turn the tide of battle, saving thousands.

Enlist Today!"

This kit is a conversion kit for the newest plastic cadians. The torsos fit the equivelant piece in the assembling book in the plastic box.

there are
7 different heads
11 different torsos

All heads can be given female proportions by decreasing their width by roughly 8%

Note: Some cutting of the plastic legs are required

A powered fist for all your guardsmen needs! scaled for the rest of the Hostile Environment Guardsmen, or as a spare / upgrade for your existing plastic models. Does not include any iconography, as it is easy to add your own with either transfers or a 3d program.

The Powerfistv2Fixed is the intended file for regular use, as it is a complete model, and cannot be posed or taken apart in any way. The "not-fixed" can be taken apart and modified in a program such as blender.



Powered fist and parts by me, built over (and remixed from) Ziocru's Angry Spaceguards Arms Clean: https://www.thingiverse.com/thing:4580213

"Each crackle of their rifles, was a death sentence to their enemies. Their old rifles had been replaced for this mission, and the soldiers had been eager to try out the fresh forge-crafted laser rifles. The normal magazines had been exchanged for a power cable, hooked up to the proto-fusion capacitators on their back; standard issue for their regiment; allowing them a much higher rate of fire, and fewer reloads than normal"

3 different variants of snipers intended for 28mm wargaming, in line with the rest of the Hostile Environment Guardsmen I've made, and also includes a standalone sniper rifle. Due to popular requests, I made sure that the cables were much thicker and wider this time, to make them easier for printing and painting.
This is also one of the few times I'll be using legs (by ZioCru, go check out his stuff), as I intend for the models I make to be used as conversion pieces, and not wholly printed models.

Enjoy!

This is a reupload as the original wasn't showing up under my designs, and I also wanted to add another version, with the sword in a resting position and a bionic arm.

"He looked over the horizon, he'd grown accustomed to the ash wastes of Teidon Prime, just like he had with the endless swamps of Delta-64-91. He'd been on countless worlds, each a different home, with different families. Families he'd soon depart with, as he once again would be the only one out of the warzone. He gave a fake smile to the corporal next to him, who smiled back unknowingly that the sergeant had done the same to last 3 men and women assigned to him. "another warzone corporal, another battle to win. Remember your training, and I'll make sure you'll be back home with your family in a couple of months". He donned his mask and yelled orders for the charge, already having said goodbye to those around him"

This is a single model, meant to represent either a veteran sergeant or higher ranking officer of the Hostile Environment Guardsmen.
He's armed with a powered sword, plasma pistol and improved armour against shrapnell.

Remixed from the following parts:
Heroic scale heads for wargaming miniatures 28mm. By Brexit: https://www.thingiverse.com/thing:3217411

https://www.thingiverse.com/thing:4693247

https://www.thingiverse.com/thing:4582571
https://www.thingiverse.com/thing:4580213

Special Thanks to ZioCru for feedback during the creation process
